Department Overview:
The Department of Basic Veterinary Sciences Was established on 12
th
December 2023. Our Aim is to contribute to the economic developments in Pakistan by providing quality education, advancing research and serving the community through excellent diagnostics and shared learning. Through support of our strong research-intensive faculty and the University, we are able to continue to provide the best possible learning experience for our students in professional degree programs to address the filed problems that directly affect our country. The Department of Basic Veterinary Sciences is the University’s most rapidly expanding discipline. The Departments has following sections.
Core Values:
Gross Anatomy
Histology and Embryology
Pharmacology and Toxicology
Physiology
Biochemistry

Chairperson Message

The need of high quality education in the country, has been anticipated since long. The modern communities are knowledgeable-based and it is inconceivable to achieve socio-economic development or nation building without trained-manpower in scientific and technological fields, particularly in the areas of merging sciences, such as Veterinary Sciences. The Basic Veterinary Sciences trained manpower, in various fields of emerging sciences, i.e Anatomy &Histology, Pharmacology and Toxicology, Physiology and Biochemistry. College of Veterinary Sciences and Animal Husbandry has now been acknowledged as one of the reputed institutes in the country. We had our difficult moments, but with the hard work by all faculty members, supporting and administration staff we managed our initial take to the righteous goals. Today, it can be proudly claimed that we had been engaged in the accomplishment of our ambition whole heartedly.

We have been vigorously pursuing our dream for achieving excellence by providing highly qualified Faculty, a challenging curriculum and an efficient administrative team. But the real assets of educational institutes are its students.
We firmly believe in producing well-qualified graduates.

Let us join with us to make this Department a model for other to follow.

Dr. Imad Khan
HOD, Department of Basic Veterinary Sciences.
